component.name: KeyDis
component.summary: Native Redis and Valkey client for KDE

description.p: KeyDis is a native Qt 6 and KDE Frameworks 6 desktop client for Redis and Valkey, built for Linux and KDE Plasma.
It provides SCAN-based key browsing, core data type viewers and editors, a command line, and a KDE-native desktop experience.
KeyDis is not affiliated with Redis Ltd., the Valkey project, or KDE e.V.
Split connection views: two tab panes side by side, with independent sessions and active-pane tab creation.
Single-window connection tabs: each tab is an independent KeyDis workspace, with a tab bar, Ctrl+T, closable/movable tabs and per-profile New Tab.
Explicit Apply/Discard for collection cell and batch edits, with local pending state and transactional commit.
Redo for collection undo history, plus dirty-state indicators and explicit Discard for String and JSON raw editors.
Parallel connections in separate native windows, with File → New Window and an Open in New Window action for saved profiles.
Daily-workflow batch: multi-select key deletion and TTL, loaded-row filtering in collection views, and a read-only String hex viewer.
RedisJSON object key rename with overwrite confirmation, using an atomic JSON.SET + JSON.DEL transaction.
SSH password authentication via SSH_ASKPASS, stored in KWallet; key/agent remains supported.
RedisJSON structural editing: add object children/array elements from the tree and delete non-root nodes.
Atomic batch edits: hash/list/set/zset multi-command operations now use MULTI/EXEC, with same-slot routing in Cluster mode and cross-slot rejection.
Undo now covers single hash field, list element and sorted-set score edits, with safe rollback on failed writes.
Batch-edit Undo for hash, list, set and sorted-set selections, with reload-safe inverse commands.
Safety guardrails: confirmation for destructive/caution CLI commands, ACL/read-only server hints, and import overwrite confirmation.
Cluster node overview now includes per-master memory, connected clients and key counts.
Cluster-wide Dashboard: aggregate memory, client, command and keyspace statistics across all cluster masters.
Connections dock grouping: collapsible groups, per-profile color markers, and persisted group state.
Connection recovery: authentication prompts after NOAUTH/WRONGPASS, one-click Retry, and error details in the status row.
Connections dock polish: empty-state guidance, selection-aware buttons, profile duplication, tabbed profile editor and direct-connection test.
Connection UX cleanup: the top connection bar is removed; all connection actions live in the Connections dock, with password and read-only controls moved there.
Connection UX: the top Connect action only makes an ephemeral connection; saved profiles are created exclusively from the Connections dock.
RedisJSON tree editor with path display and scalar editing; Cluster node overview; JSON formatting.
Partial collection editing: batch hash/list/zset edits, HMSET fallback, set member rename, and SETRANGE string replacement.

Cluster-aware workbench: slot routing, cluster-wide SCAN, KRunner integration, Dashboard, namespace tree, core type editing, profiles with KWallet, server tools, memory analysis, transfer, Stream/JSON, Sentinel/SSH, Chinese translation.
